BASIC: Aim toward the hole. Hold the black button to build power, then release to shoot.
RIM: Watch the bounce. Aim at the edge to bounce your puck toward the hole.
BANK: This blue wall gives a strong bounce. Use it to reach around the corner.
MUD: See the difference. A weak shot stops in the sticky honey. Hold longer for more power, then release to shoot through it.
MOVE: The hole is moving. Watch its path, and aim where it will be when your puck arrives.
ICE: Ice is slippery. Your puck travels farther here. Try a gentle shot.
FAST: These arrows speed up your puck. Aim through the boost and watch it zoom.
POINTS: Collect the golden pickups for extra points. Then get your puck into the hole.
HAZARD: Watch out for pink traps. They cost a heart. Aim around them.
PUSH: This floor pushes your puck in the arrow direction. Adjust your aim to stay on course.
WIND: Wind pushes your puck sideways. Aim against the wind to reach the hole.
PULL: This gravity well pulls your puck closer. Aim wide and let the pull bend your shot.
JUMP: The launch pad sends your puck in the arrow direction. Use it to reach the next part of the board.
KICK: This bumper gives your puck a powerful kick. Plan where the puck will bounce next.
WARP: These portals are connected. Enter one, and your puck comes out of the other.
SLIDE: This wall slides back and forth. Wait for a clear gap, then shoot.
SPIN: This wall spins. Watch its rhythm and shoot when the path is clear.
GATE: This gate opens and closes. Wait until it disappears, then send your puck through.
PEGS: Aim through the gap between the posts. A careful straight shot will reach the hole.
